theme: Light theme matching iOS minimal aesthetic

headings.usage: H1/H2 for an elegant, high-end, under-used serif look.

body.usage: Clean, highly readable geometric sans for app UI, settings, labels, and metrics.

guidelines: Headlines MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Never use Inter, Space Grotesk, or Roboto.
Small labels MUST be uppercase + wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Use fluid scaling up to text-5xl maximum for largest headers, keeping typography restrained for mobile.
Use Coral (#C95F3E) strictly for Delete/Destructive left swipes and primary call-to-actions.
Use Soft Sage (#E4EDE5) for Keep/Success right swipes and subtle tag backgrounds.
Use Honey (#F0C85B) for Favorite/Up swipes and achievement badges.
Surface backgrounds like cards or drawers should be pristine white (#FFFFFF) to stand out against the Warm Cream (#F6F3ED) background.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.

layouts.structure: Mobile-first PWA. Root container must have max-w-[440px] mx-auto, h-screen, centered on desktop inside a neutral canvas (e.g., bg-stone-100 or bg-[#ebe7df] outside the mobile frame).
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards, large touch targets (min 48x48px).

components.swipe_stack: Absolute positioned deck of cards taking up the majority of the view height. Drag constraints and visual feedback on swipe thresholds.
components.bottom_actions: Fixed at the bottom of the mobile frame with three tactile pill-shaped or circular buttons (Delete, Favorite, Keep) mapping to swipe actions.
components.drawers: Use framer-motion or a customized Shadcn Drawer for the confirm-before-delete queue.
components.achievements: Grid layout for badges (Space Saver, Streak, Burst Buster, etc.) using Soft Sage or Honey accents and soft shadows.

motion.swipe_cards: Framer Motion drag='x,y'. Use dragElastic and dragConstraints. Rotate cards based on drag X offset (e.g., transform: rotate(dragX * 0.1)). Fade out smoothly on swipe completion.
motion.haptic_feedback: Use navigator.vibrate([50]) when a drag threshold is passed to simulate haptic feedback (or fallback gracefully if unsupported).
motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade and slide for entering settings, drawer toggles, or achievement screens.

components.ui_libraries: framer-motion for swiping and micro-interactions. lucide-react for iconography.
components.customization: Use pill tags, soft diffuse ambient shadows (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.08)]), and heavily rounded corners (rounded-3xl for cards) mirroring premium iOS style.
components.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Do not use fully transparent overlays where text sits.
accessibility.interactions: Provide on-screen fallback buttons for swiping (left/up/right) for users unable to perform drag gestures.
accessibility.testing: Include data-testid='...' on all interactive components (buttons, swipe cards, settings toggles) for robust automated testing.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where necessary, but keep it crystal clear and purposeful.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container text via global CSS.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡�🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text for images.
Use .js/.jsx extensions for React components, NOT .tsx.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
No HTML default elements for complex inputs (use Shadcn components for selects, dialogs, etc).

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Create the app structure using a mobile-first frame (max-w-[440px]) centered horizontally and vertically on desktop. Implement a permission-gated simulated photo library picker to act as device photo access.
features: Swipeable Cards: Implement with Framer Motion. Left = Delete (Coral), Right = Keep (Sage), Up = Favorite (Honey). Integrate simulated haptic feedback on threshold cross.
Undo Feature: Temporarily store swiped cards in a state stack and provide an 'Undo' button to reverse the last swipe action.
Burst Grouping: Visually indicate photos grouped by timestamp/dimensions (e.g., a stacked card effect behind the main card).
Storage Tracker: Progress bar showing MB/GB saved with gamified level progression.
Delete Queue: A drawer sliding from the bottom, presenting the left-swiped photos to confirm deletion.
Achievements: Render a dedicated modal/screen for badges ('First Clear', 'Clean Sweep', 'Space Saver 100MB', 'Streak 3', etc.).
Settings Screen: A minimalist screen focusing on the 'nothing leaves your phone' privacy messaging.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Enforce the Warm Cream & Coral clean minimal palette strictly. Use fluid animations and ensure all cards and buttons feel highly tactile. Apply Spectral for headings to contrast beautifully against Manrope for body text.
